# Ideal Bath Renovations

> Ideal Bath Renovations is a premier licensed bathroom remodeling contractor based in Langley Township, British Columbia. We specialize in full-service bathroom renovations, tub-to-shower conversions, curbless walk-in showers, custom bathroom vanities, and Schluter® certified waterproofing systems across Langley Twp, Surrey, Abbotsford, and the Fraser Valley.

## Core Bathroom Remodeling Services
- **Full Master Bathroom Remodeling:** Complete architectural design, demolition, structural plumbing, electrical upgrades, designer vanities, freestanding bathtubs, and luxury fixtures. [Learn More](https://www.idealbathrenovations.ca/services/bathroom-remodeling)
- **Tub-to-Shower Conversions:** Converting dated bathtubs into modern, accessible, low-maintenance walk-in shower enclosures with custom frameless glass. [Learn More](https://www.idealbathrenovations.ca/services/shower-remodeling)
- **Curbless & Barrier-Free Walk-In Showers:** Zero-threshold, aging-in-place shower systems with linear drains, integrated grab bars, and slip-resistant mosaic floors. [Learn More](https://www.idealbathrenovations.ca/services/shower-remodeling)
- **Custom Tile & Schluter® Waterproofing:** Large-format porcelain, ceramic, and marble tile installation backed by 100% waterproof Schluter-KERDI membranes and 24-hour flood testing. [Learn More](https://www.idealbathrenovations.ca/services/bathroom-tile-installation)
- **Custom Vanities & Storage:** Solid wood cabinetry, quartz/granite countertops, undermount sinks, LED vanity mirrors, and customized linen towers. [Learn More](https://www.idealbathrenovations.ca/services/bathroom-vanity-installation)
- **Bathtub Replacement & Freestanding Tubs:** Soaker tubs, alcove replacements, and freestanding focal tubs with floor-mounted faucets. [Learn More](https://www.idealbathrenovations.ca/services/bathtub-replacement)
- **In-Floor Radiant Heating:** Schluter® DITRA-HEAT electric floor warming with smart Wi-Fi thermostats. [Learn More](https://www.idealbathrenovations.ca/services/bathroom-tile-installation)
- **Bathroom Repairs, Restorations & Upgrades:** Leak repair, subfloor reinforcement, mold remediation, and cosmetic modernization. [Learn More](https://www.idealbathrenovations.ca/services/bathroom-repair)

## Renovation Process
1. **Free In-Home Consultation & Measurement:** Detailed on-site review of your bathroom layout, plumbing considerations, and design goals.
2. **Itemized Transparent Written Proposal:** Fixed-price estimates with clear breakdowns for labor, plumbing fixtures, waterproofing, and tile.
3. **Dust-Controlled Demolition & Structural Prep:** Clean extraction with floor protection, HEPA air scrubbers, and subfloor inspection.
4. **Certified Plumbing, Electrical & Schluter Waterproofing:** Precision mechanicals and leak-proof membrane installation.
5. **Tile, Vanity & Fixture Installation:** Master craftsman tile setting, vanity leveling, glass door installation, and fixture trim-out.
6. **Final Inspection & Multi-Year Warranty Handover:** Thorough walkthrough, clean-up, care guide, and warranty documentation.
